court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Additional District Judge, Court No. 13, Ghaziabad in Civil Appeal No. 63 of 2017
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Appellant was married to respondent's son Vijay Gandhi and had two children. Vijay deserted the appellant and filed a divorce petition. Appellant claimed relief for eviction of defendant from suit property.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot go beyond its pleadings and evidence produced by the parties, if any, cannot be considered in absence of pleadings.
legal_principles.held: This Court has consistently held that the court cannot go beyond the pleadings of the parties. The parties have to take proper pleadings and establish by adducing evidence that by a particular irregularity/illegality, the result of the election has been 'materially affected'.
cited_cases: Arikala Narasa Reddy versus Venkata Ram Reddy Reddygari (2014) 5 SCC 312
Sujata Gandhi vs S.B. Gandhi on 12 June, 2020

legal_principles.principle: A party should not be permitted to travel beyond its pleadings and parties are bound to take all necessary and material facts in support of the case set up by them.
legal_principles.held: No party should be permitted to travel beyond its pleadings and parties are bound to take all necessary and material facts in support of the case set up by them.
cited_cases: Arikala Narasa Reddy versus Venkata Ram Reddy Reddygari (2014) 5 SCC 312

outcome.final_order: The appeal was allowed, and the judgment and decree passed by the trial court were set aside.
